posts.t: Östlund called for slashing with 39 seconds left in the Sabres' power play.
Sabres power play comes to an end with 39 seconds left in it thanks to a Noah Östlund slash that the fans don't agree with upon seeing it on the video board
Top power-play unit looked the best it has so far this young season. Movement and chances, including a nifty move from Ostlund in front.
